ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $O$ is the circumcenter of $\triangle ABC$, and $\angle ABC=40^\circ$, $\angle ACB=70^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle BOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given: $\because$ $\angle ABC=40^\circ$ and $\angle ACB=70^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BAC=180^\circ-40^\circ-70^\circ=70^\circ$,\\
$\because$ O is the circumcenter of $\triangle ABC$,\\
$\therefore$ the circle with center O and radius OB is the circumcircle of $\triangle ABC$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BOC=2\angle BAC=\boxed{140^\circ}$.
